statement:
I'll look up the record for column GC-441 to see what the midterm grades information shows.
The record shows 180 midterm exam scores ranging from 6 to 10 points (on the 10-point marking scale), with the Canvas column set to 100 points possible—meaning I need to convert the 10-point scores to the 100-point scale by multiplying by 10.

Since the marking file contains all 180 student scores already calculated and the teaching assistant prepared them on Monday, I will post these grades to Canvas using the marking file data converted to the 100-point scale.
The midterm grades for column GC-441 have been successfully posted to Canvas. All 180 student scores from the marking file have been converted from the 10-point scale to the 100-point scale and are now visible in the gradebook.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer names the specific mismatch—"the Canvas column set to 100 points possible" versus 10-point scores—and supplies the correction by "multiplying by 10" before posting.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
